note: Ramond-Elliott neurodevelopmental syndrome is characterized by developmental delay/intellectual disability, microcephaly, and related neurological features in affected individuals.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 12 individuals with TRA2B variants, all affected individuals presented intellectual disability and/or developmental delay, frequently associated with microcephaly, infantile spasms, brain anomalies, and feeding difficulties.

source.title: Clustered variants in the 5' coding region of TRA2B cause ...
source.quote: A total of 12 individuals from 11 unrelated families who harbored predicted loss-of-function monoallelic variants, mostly de novo, were recruited. ... All affected individuals presented intellectual disability and/or developmental delay, frequently associated with infantile spasms, microcephaly, brain anomalies, autism spectrum disorder, feeding difficulties, and short stature.

evidence.text: Ramond-Elliott neurodevelopmental syndrome (OMIM #621421) features variable manifestations including poor overall growth, dysmorphic facial features, feeding difficulties, and brain atrophy on MRI.
